The [[Wilderness Agility Course]] offers the fastest experience rates from level 47 to 62. Level 52 is normally required to enter the course, but this can be boosted from level 47 with a [[summer pie]]. However, level 49 is required to pass the [[Obstacle pipe (Wilderness Agility Course)|pipe obstacle]], requiring occasional re-boosting if below.

The easiest way to get there is to break an [[Ice plateau teleport (tablet)|Ice Plateau Teleport tablet]] and run slightly south-east. Because this method involves the deep [[Wilderness]], players should keep the risk to the minimum as there is a good chance of encountering [[player killing|player killers]]. Bring some [[Summer pie|summer pies]] to boost the Agility level and to heal the damage taken from failing the obstacles. Additionally, bring a [[knife]] or [[Wilderness sword 1|Wilderness sword]] to slash [[Web|webs]] when going to the [[Mage Arena]] to bank for more supplies. [[Boots of lightness]] and the [[spottier cape]] can be worn to [[Weight-reducing clothing|reduce weight]].

The experience bonus, [[wilderness agility ticket]], and [[Energy|run energy]] refill at the end of the lap is only received if the player has passed all the obstacles in order. If the player fails the [[Log balance (Wilderness Agility Course)|log balance]], walk past the [[Stepping stone (Wilderness Agility Course)|stepping stones]] to cross it again to be able to receive the completion bonus.

Players can gain around 50,000–60,000 experience per hour when including fails and wilderness agility tickets. It also provides alchables, noted [[Blighted|blighted items]], and [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scrolls]], making it a potentially [[Money making guide/Wilderness Agility Course|lucrative money maker]], even for [[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]].
